scope: 25 distinct audit questions about deterministic state modeling; one new bounded structural advisory, existing semantic owners retained.
routing: sarj-ai/code-standards, because source semantics and binding/write relationships establish the finding; paths alone cannot.
privacy: Private source paths, revisions, content digests, native hit details and exact local commands remain in an owner-readable overlay. Public fixtures are synthetic. This report contains redacted aggregates.

rankedDecisions.predicate: Existing producer-proven literal/typed immutable primitive relationships.
rankedDecisions.proofBoundary: One producer does not close a shared contract or all runtime writers.
rankedDecisions.positive: Two strict equality projections over one finite immutable snapshot.
rankedDecisions.negative: Independent history/current state, nullable/open domains or repeated getters.
rankedDecisions.fix: Existing tightly bounded unused-private type-only fix; no projection/ownership fix.

rankedDecisions.predicate: Genuine lexical useState const tuples in one owner; observed value reads; at least two complete adjacent direct setter groups in distinct transition functions; every setter reference accounted for; identical maximal run membership; at least one group reads properties of one stable transition-local record binding.
rankedDecisions.proofBoundary: Repeated source bookkeeping only. Object immutability, getter purity, domain intent, batching, atomicity and absence of runtime races are not established.
rankedDecisions.positive: Direct page-field adoption plus reset, or repeated adoption of a saved record.
rankedDecisions.negative: Only shared resets, independent writers, editable drafts, escaped setters, transformed/functional updater RHSs, intervening calls or suspension.
knownMisses: A maximal group with an unsupported record-valued RHS can hide a smaller useful subgroup.
rankedDecisions.promotion: Reject: an intentional mirror control remains a non-actionable warning, and natural defect precision is unmeasured.

rankedDecisions.predicate: No admitted standalone predicate. Counts/names/nullable fields are review queries.

rankedDecisions.positive: A supported complete direct group may be reviewed by B.
rankedDecisions.negative: Controlled open callbacks and independently completing requests.

rankedDecisions.predicate: Retain current dictionary, validated discriminator and nullable-outcome owners.

rankedDecisions.negative: History versus pending work, reporting versus cleanup, persisted invitation plus email failure.

passes.question: Revision and effective consumer setup
passes.evidence: Fetched both heads before editing; read manifests, native configs and lockfiles; installed the exact consumer plugins separately.
passes.result: Source and installed TypeScript both report the hook; actual consumer config promotes it to error. SARJ571 is absent from consumer Python. Full-profile replay also has two missing-dependency tsconfig errors, disclosed separately.
passes.changedDecision: Freeze corpus pins; do not confuse source availability with installed policy.

passes.question: Admission
passes.evidence: Disposable bounded lexical query; direct review of every resulting natural candidate and every writer/reader.
passes.result: One two-slot saved-record opportunity repeats adoption/reset at three sites. Separate writers for editable fields remain outside that group. Minimal direct-page reproduction has the same gap. Concrete cost is repeated transition bookkeeping, not an observed runtime defect.
passes.changedDecision: Admit a named structural warning with no fix; reject broad defect claims.

passes.question: Routing
passes.evidence: AGENTS.md and plugins/sarj-skills/skills/lint-rule-generator/SKILL.md; binding and writer evidence.
passes.result: Filename or tree topology cannot establish the relationship. No new Git-tree policy is needed.
passes.changedDecision: Implement in Oxlint source-semantic owner.

passes.question: Live catalog
passes.evidence: Rule source/docs, source-owned Python descriptors, strict preset, plugin registry, ledger, live inventory, packaged catalog, migration map and stage2 additions.
passes.result: SARJ510 remains error; other design owners remain warnings. New post-migration rule is recorded in stage2 additions rather than inventing an ESLint migration alias.
passes.changedDecision: Synchronize all source-owned and generated artifacts; preserve historical aliases.

passes.question: Upstream overlap
passes.evidence: Primary React/React Doctor docs plus installed oxlint-plugin-react-doctor 0.9.22 source, registry and native probes.
passes.result: Online 0.9.3 descriptions differ from installed behavior. Five declarations alone do not report; installed reducer query is disabled by default and requires five co-writes. It emits one broader six-slot inventory warning on the natural candidate. Cascading rule remains retired.
passes.changedDecision: Keep the new exact group advisory distinct from broader optional inventory; no native-owner replacement.

passes.question: Natural-positive replay
passes.evidence: run_isolated_corpora: 1,049 production frontend files; exact installed/source plugins; four repeated baseline/candidate scans.
passes.result: One existing projection and one new coordinated group; combined mode has two stable, nonduplicate diagnostics. All ten supplied frontend seeds replayed; none meets the new narrow complete-group predicate.
passes.changedDecision: Reuse projection owner and retain narrow recall; do not manufacture seed coverage.

passes.question: Natural-negative replay
passes.evidence: Current track/history/timeout, independent reporting/cleanup, accepted/pending message sets, failover/restart, nested ending, published/draft, capacity snapshots, invitation/email source.
passes.result: No new coordinated React hit on the two named frontend controls. SARJ565 reports none on the frozen Python corpus. Some negative-control files also contain separate SARJ510/SARJ571 model-contract findings; they are not evidence against their independent scalar lifetimes.
passes.changedDecision: Retain independent axes; do not call syntactically quiet files labeled true negatives.

passes.question: Hook provenance
passes.evidence: Owning RuleTester named/renamed/default/namespace/erased-wrapper cases, shadowing, foreign/type-only/custom hooks and overwritten members.
passes.result: Lexical import helper correctly accepts React identities and abstains for unsupported provenance.
passes.changedDecision: Reuse react-prop-bindings.ts; no name-only hook recognition.

passes.question: Binding ownership
passes.evidence: Tuple binding tests and all setter reference inspection; const destructured incoming records tested.
passes.result: Aliases, escapes, controlled callback props, unread values and rebinding exclude affected slots. A type-only reference does not escape a setter.
passes.changedDecision: No interprocedural alias guessing; preserve smaller justified groups.

passes.question: Writer completeness
passes.evidence: Run membership tests: extra writer, separate guards, early return, different source order, independently written third slot and maximal triple.
passes.result: Equal counts do not qualify. Exact complete run membership produces one diagnostic per maximal disjoint slot group in declaration order.
passes.changedDecision: Account for every observed setter use before reporting.

passes.question: Shared snapshot proof
passes.evidence: Direct adoption/reset example, common-local-binding witness, different roots, module captures, optional/computed reads, transforms and functional appenders.
passes.result: A non-reset record witness is required; reset-only groups abstain. A stable object binding does not prove pure properties. All runtime source remains untouched.
passes.changedDecision: Report structural common-source reads; abstain for transformations and preserve evaluation order.

passes.question: Finite-state proof
passes.evidence: Affected prefer-discriminated-union suite and sum-type native compiler/runtime contracts.
passes.result: 253 existing TypeScript cases pass initially, covering false/false, independent dimensions, enum runtime identity, nullable/open domains, budget limits and shared broader contracts.
passes.changedDecision: No finite-state inference or duplicate rule added.

passes.question: Payload dependency
passes.evidence: SARJ510/SARJ571 source, stronger-owner precedence tests, produced-union tests and explicit null/undefined boundaries.
passes.result: Presence is distinct from payload value validation. Strong validator evidence and nullable outcome advice retain separate severity/diagnostic owners.

passes.question: Framework ownership
passes.evidence: Private request/form/subscription/query/transition source and read-only prop fixtures.
passes.result: Request pending state, compiler-sensitive subscriptions, first-render form seeds and independently editable drafts are deliberate owners.
passes.changedDecision: Do not infer replacement from field names or counts.

passes.question: Concurrency and scheduling
passes.evidence: Request-counter source, synchronous start lock, nested transition functions; awaited RHS, intervening await and separately scheduled callback tests.
passes.result: New rule never rewrites or replaces request identity. Unsupported scheduling/suspension within the proposed group abstains; adjacent calls after a guarded awaited result may qualify structurally.
passes.changedDecision: No race/atomicity claim; async overlap remains a separate review.

passes.question: Cleanup and task lifetime
passes.evidence: Private close/reopen cancellation paths, listener disposal, exception observation, task cancellation/join and ending-outlives-stop source.
passes.result: Those lifetimes remain distinct from repeated setter bookkeeping. No runtime cleanup or cancellation code changes.
passes.changedDecision: Reject lifecycle collapse; keep no-fix policy.

passes.question: Wire and persistence contracts
passes.evidence: Saved-record readers, partial-success invite constructors, model-copy/serialization boundaries, shared contract fixtures and native narrowing contracts.
passes.result: Nullable failure can coexist with a persisted retry resource. Public constructors and broad schemas cannot be narrowed from one local producer. New advisory changes no schemas or emitted application code.
passes.changedDecision: Defer ownership/schema migrations to a separate reader/writer review.

passes.question: False-positive attack
passes.evidence: Labeled independent five-state component, nested guards, drafts, independent third writer and intentional mirror fixture; natural historical/current controls.
passes.result: Reset/count-only controls abstain. An intentional mirror with identical source transitions still receives structural advice. It is explicitly a valid, non-actionable domain case, not a confirmed defect.
passes.changedDecision: Ship warning only; reject error promotion and any count-based generalization.

passes.question: Autofix safety
passes.evidence: Every candidate RuleTester match requires output:null; native contract checks absent fix metadata; existing type-only producer runtime/compiler contracts.
passes.result: No ownership fix is offered. Initializer calls, functional updater semantics, comments, identity, exceptions and property evaluation cannot be preserved by a generic migration.
passes.changedDecision: Keep all ownership changes manual; existing bounded type-only owner unchanged.

passes.question: Diagnostics and suppression
passes.evidence: Maximal triple, stable naming/source-line assertions, native positive/shadowed/suppressed/positive files and warning exit check.
passes.result: One diagnostic per complete group; exact-code suppression works, suppression for another owner does not hide it; warning exits 0, --deny-warnings exits 1. Actual combined-profile overlap is zero. Opted-in broader upstream inventory can also flag the component.
passes.changedDecision: Retain warning semantics; add no baselines or broad suppressions.

passes.question: Oxlint file isolation
passes.evidence: Native single-process --threads 1 sequence plus helper cache source review.
passes.result: before() clears slot arrays and budget state. Helpers key caches by AST/binding identity, not reused SourceCode identity. Last positive still reports after shadowed and suppressed files.
passes.changedDecision: No file-persistent mutable candidate cache.

passes.question: Bounds and degraded modes
passes.evidence: File source/node/slot limits, setter reference boundary/overflow, path-depth overflow, generated/declaration/test filters and untyped cases.
passes.result: File budget overflow emits no partial groups; unsupported setter use excludes that slot. New rule has zero type queries and no missing-types fallback. Native parser owns malformed input.
passes.changedDecision: Keep conservative bounded abstention; no partial proof under budget exhaustion.

passes.question: Fixture and native contracts
passes.evidence: Oxlint RuleTester, three executable examples, native file/suppression/exit contract and affected Python harness.
passes.result: 63 labeled RuleTester cases plus two integration/example tests pass (65 owning-module tests). Initial affected existing suites: 253 TypeScript and 375 Python tests pass. New rule makes no narrowing or runtime transformation claim.
passes.changedDecision: Use native contracts for service/isolation claims; no implementation-mirroring application tests.

passes.question: Corpus and performance
passes.evidence: Immutable owner-only manifests, run_isolated_corpora with fresh 250-file batches, four alternating rounds and per-child RSS.
passes.result: Frontend: 1 new + 1 retained hit; Python: 0 dictionary, 6 union and 11 outcome findings, all inspected structurally. Zero duplicate locations. Rule-only median increases ~0.37s; combined medians vary within shared-host noise.
passes.changedDecision: Report raw counts, partial type-service coverage and cost; no fleet precision, recall or speedup claim.

passes.question: Lifecycle and final challenge
passes.evidence: maintain rules new/verify/prepare/evaluate; index regeneration, metadata/catalog/preset/addition registration, version/sibling pins, generated docs and make verify.
passes.result: One accepted bounded warning, no changes to stronger existing rules. Other hypotheses have explicit reuse/reject/manual dispositions. Initial verification exposed missing generated metadata and post-migration registration; both were corrected. Final statuses are recorded below.
passes.changedDecision: Recommend warning publication only after normal reviewed release. No merge, publication or consumer rollout is authorized by this audit.

naturalEvaluation.selection: Tracked production frontend and Python source; explicit test/spec/fixture/declaration/generated/client/script exclusions are pinned privately. Files are not automatically assigned negative labels.

python.inspection: All diagnostic definitions/annotations were reviewed. Six unions meet the existing structural tag policy; eleven nullable records remain warning-level lifecycle/wire review opportunities. No whole-program runtime-defect label or constructor closure is claimed.

naturalEvaluation.typeCoverage: New rule is syntax/scope only with zero type queries. Existing projection emits under installed/source tsrs and disappears in untyped mode. Only the relevant React/enum dependencies were installed, not the full private application graph; two full-profile tsconfig errors are disclosed. Zero other typed hits do not establish recall.
naturalEvaluation.suppression: Raw fresh workers use an external cwd without automatic consumer suppression counts. A prior direct corpus replay encountered unused-suppression summaries; these were not counted as rule hits. Effective consumer replay promotes the projection to error. Native effect hit has one existing exact consumer baseline entry; no suppression was added.
naturalEvaluation.revisionDrift: Consumer remote advanced after the audit pin. Source manifests were not repinned; the accepted natural candidate and projection source did not change in the observed advance. One original dialog seed did change and remains qualified only at the frozen pin.

labeledSyntheticEvaluation.unit: A named RuleTester case labeled for this exact structural predicate; not an application runtime defect.

actionabilityAttack.interpretation: The one explicit intentional-mirror case is structurally detected but need not be refactored. These authored labels do not estimate natural field precision.

labeledSyntheticEvaluation.seededConsumerCases: Ten supplied frontend seeds are not synthetic confusion-matrix denominators; the existing projection owner catches one. The new rule abstains on all ten; the natural new opportunity was found outside those seeds.

performance.method: Four rounds alternate forward/reverse baseline/candidate order. Every 250-file batch starts fresh Python/Oxlint processes on identical pinned inputs, with one native thread. No filesystem caches were flushed; all runs follow earlier source reads. Wall sums exclude outer Python worker startup; each child includes native startup, plugin loading, parsing and analysis. RSS is the maximum waited-process observation per round, not simultaneous process-family memory.
performance.interpretation: Rule-only median increases 0.372039s versus a zero-rule baseline that still loads the baseline plugin. Combined medians are 1.290147s before and 1.278866s after; this difference is noise, not an improvement claim. Later-round medians increase from 1.252529s to 1.271284s. Native memory grows in the rule-only comparison; no memory optimization is claimed.
